basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a high school student from the US, diving into the vast world of Reddit in my free time. I'm really into Star Wars, animation, and a bit of fan fiction writing. I also have a curious interest in cultural topics and humor! I usually browse Reddit after school and during late nights, especially when I need a break from homework. I'm single and still figuring out what I want to do in the future, maybe something in the arts or media.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic educational background as a high school student, which means I learn a lot from school and the internet. I'm particularly self-taught in arts and storytelling, sourcing inspiration from movies and online communities.
